title: Funny moments: Vic Dickenson in Brooklyn and Walter Page at the Apollo
summary: In Brooklyn a high Vic Dickenson started playing after the band ended and the band backed him with riffs. At the Apollo Walter Page fell off the stand but kept holding up the bass.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And I'll never forget one time, we were playing at a theatre in Brooklyn and the Band had just got through playing there, you know, and they had stopped and Vic Dickenson jumped up and commenced to playing. Now see, he was high. Basie said, 'what's that . . . B-B-B- (laughs), what's he doing'. And then so they all had to commence to putting riffs behind him, you know, because they had ended; and then he just picked it up because he didn't know what they was playing cause he was out of it. That was the funniest thing. And then another time we were at the Apollo and, what was the bass player's name?

Walter Page. We was just playing and playing and we looked around and there was the bass up in there. He done fell off the stand. (laughs) There was the bass--- I said, oh, my Lord, did he hurt hisself. No, he was just holding the bass up standing down there just a pickin ... I said, oh, my goodness!
